Chapter 581 - Horrible Master

Chapter 581 - Horrible Master

The size of this ship was double that of the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship, and it had almost a hundred pirates onboard.

On top of that were three Sovereigns.

One of them was a male in silver – the pirate who spoke earlier. Next to him was a female with a black veil over her face. Her pair of eyes was as calm as water.

However, neither of them were the true leader of the Metal Triangle Pirates.

At the top of the ship sat a large purple-faced male wearing beast-skin clothes who gave off a feeling of metal. A rusty metallic triangle hung on his neck.

“Surround them!”

The purple-faced male laughed.

“Metal Triangle Pirate Captain, this whale was killed by me. Since you’re here, you can have everything except the heart blood essence.”

The elder wearing the shirt said. If it was a one-on-one, he wouldn’t give up, but the current situation was looking extremely bad for him. The opponents were three Sovereigns, and the two youths next to him were just luggage.

“Hahaha, Third Elder of the Gan Cloud Pavilion, you don’t seem to know what’s going on. This isn’t the territory of the Gan Cloud Pavilion. The ocean around here is my territory.”

The captain of the Metal Triangle Pirates roared in laughter.

“What do you want?”

The expression of the elder became grim.

The Gan Cloud Pavilion was one of the stronger forces around; it had reached one-and-a-half stars.

Although the captain of the Metal Triangle Pirates knew the elder, he didn’t seem to care. The limitless ocean was the territory of pirates and beasts.

As long as they weren’t from a two-star sect, the Metal Triangle Pirate Captain didn’t fear them.

“Hehe, what do I want? This is the territory of the Metal Triangle Pirates. Everything is mine.”

Mockery appeared on the Metal Triangle Pirate Captain’s face.

“Old man, if you know what to do then you should just fuck off and we’ll consider not killing you.”

The male in silver laughed.

“Ridiculous!”

The expression of the shirt-wearing elder became extremely ugly, and he started to tremble in anger. On land, if he wanted rain, then there was rain. If he wanted wind, then there was wind. All normal Small Origin Core Realm Sovereigns were respectful to him.

The pirates started to surround them, and some even started to dissect the whale.

The captain of the Metal Triangle Pirates looked coldly at the elder, and the elder’s eyes flashed. His gaze suddenly landed on Zhao Feng and the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship, and his eyes lit up; there was another Sovereign within the ship.

When speaking with Zhao Feng before, he didn’t pay too much attention to a measly Small Origin Core Realm, but he noticed it now.

Furthermore, Zhao Feng’s soul was also extremely powerful, and the elder sensed that.

The fact that their ship didn’t break in the limitless ocean whale’s body meant that it wasn’t normal either.

“Little friend and fellow Sovereign, you can see the current situation. The Metal Triangle Pirates don’t put anyone in their eyes, and they’re bloodthirsty. Even if we give the limitless ocean whale to them, they won’t let you live.”

The elder said through Spiritual Sense.

The only thing he could do to fight back against the Metal Triangle Pirates was to get Zhao Feng and company on his side.

“Brat, if you try to work with this old man, then don’t blame me for ripping you into pieces and feeding you to some fish.”

The captain of the Metal Triangle Pirates threatened.

The eyes of the pirate leaders were full of greed as they looked at the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship. They could tell that it was a high-quality ship.

Although they wouldn’t attack the shirt-wearing since they were still wary of his strength, they wouldn’t give up an opportunity to plunder weaker foes.

“Senior, you saved us from the whale. We obviously won’t decline teaming up.”

Zhao Feng didn’t bother with the threatening eyes of the Metal Triangle Pirates.

“Good.”

The heart of the elder started beating quicker. With the help of Zhao Feng and company, the strength between both sides became more even, but the outcome would still be decided primarily by the two Great Origin Core Realms.

“I’ll give these two juniors to you.”

The elder waved his hand and pushed the pair of youths onto the ship, then he charged toward the captain of the Metal Triangle Pirates with a powerful aura.

“Old man, you dare to fight me?”

The captain of the Metal Triangle Pirates licked his lips and charged toward the elder with a gruesome expression.

Bam~~ Boom~~~

The two Great Origin Core Realms clashed, creating waves that spread across more than a dozen miles.

Everyone only saw two small black dots clash across the sky.

“Kill everyone else.”

The captain of the Metal Triangle Pirates laughed and tried to put pressure on the shirt-wearing elder’s heart.

He was confident in his subordinates.

The shirt-wearing elder went all-out, and the momentum of a Great Origin Core Realm caused the environment to change. However, his opponent was also a Great Origin Core Realm that was experienced in battle.

Even after some time, the shirt-wearing elder didn’t have any advantage. He couldn’t help but worry and feel uneasy for Zhao Feng and company.

However, the young captain was surprisingly calm and didn’t panic, while the sailors acted as if they were facing a powerful foe as they opened the protective array of the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship.

“Zhishui, protect the ship.”

Zhao Feng ordered.

The Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship’s defense should be able to last for an hour as long as there wasn’t an Origin Core Realm attacking it.

As for the actual battle, that landed on the skeletal Division Leader and himself.

Shua! Shua!

Zhao Feng and the skeletal Division Leader stood at the head of the ship.

“That youth is your captain?”

The pretty female said as she looked at the calm Zhao Feng. Zhao Feng was extremely young but had the cultivation at the half-step Origin Core Realm. There was no one as spectacular on the island they were from.

Furthermore, even the Sovereign seemed to listen to him.

“Master, there’s two Sovereigns. Which one are you going to choose?”

The flames in the skeletal Division Leader’s eyes jumped around as it laughed.

Whoosh! Whoosh!

At this moment, the male in silver and the black-veiled woman led a group of pirates and were charging over.

They also sent a section of their force to try to dissect the whale and enter its body.

“I’ll leave both of them to you.”

Zhao Feng said emotionlessly.

“What…?”

The skeletal Division Leader almost fell over.

Of the two Sovereigns, one had reached the middle-stage Small Origin Core Realm, and the other was at the late-stage Small Origin Core Realm.

Without the Ghost Corpse Cursed Array, it would be hard for it to fight against the two.

“And don’t use the Ghost Corpse Cursed Array.”

Zhao Feng added, which made the skeletal Division Leader even more bitter.

Ever since becoming Zhao Feng’s slave, it never seemed to have an easy time. It was almost shattered multiple times.

Shua!

Zhao Feng left a faint purple afterimage behind as he flew toward the pirates that were heading toward the whale.

“It’s just a half-step Origin Core Realm.”

The two pirate leaders didn’t put Zhao Feng in their eyes because there were more than ten people that had also reached the half-step Origin Core Realm among the pirates.

In their eyes, the skeletal Division Leader was the biggest threat.

The situation would be heavily affected as long as they slew it.

“Kill!”

The two pirate leaders leapt toward the skeletal Division Leader.

Whoosh! Whoosh!

The skeletal Division Leader merged the Nine Deadly Yin Bone into its body and used a secret technique.

Weng~~

Its body became two or three yards taller and started to smoke, becoming some kind of flaming bone giant.

Bam~~~~

The flaming bone giant thrusted out its palm and sent the male flying.

“What great strength. There seems to be an aura of a powerful Earth-Grade weapon.”

The male almost spat out a mouthful of blood as an air of Death and Yin entered his body.

The expression of the black-veiled woman changed slightly. She didn’t think that this skeleton would be so strong.

“Go~~!”

She pointed with her finger and a pale white flame radiating an air of evil and death charged toward the skeletal Division Leader.

On top of that:

Whoosh!

She summoned a skeleton that gave off black flames, which also charged toward the skeletal Division Leader.

“A ghost-corpse at the Origin Core Realm!”

The skeletal Division Leader couldn’t help but exclaim, and its expression changed. This was the first time it had seen a Sovereign ghost-corpse.

It was obvious that the black-veiled female cultivated in techniques similar to the skeletal Division Leader.

Ding! Ding! Boom~~~~!

At this moment, two pirate leaders and a Sovereign ghost-corpse attacked the skeletal Division Leader.

“Why is it me every time…?”

The skeletal Division Leader almost exploded from anger, but luckily, after merging with the Nine Deadly Yin Bone, the flaming bone giant’s defense and strength increased dramatically.

Ding! Ding! Ding!

The attacks from the Sovereign ghost-corpse created sparks as its attacks landed on the flaming bone giant. It wouldn’t cause much of a threat for a while.

At the same time, the skeletal Division Leader cursed its master who ran away from this fight.

“Hehe, the stronger you are, the more responsible you should be.”

Zhao Feng was slightly surprised by what he saw. Not only had the skeletal Division Leader become stronger, the black-veiled woman summoned a Sovereign ghost-corpse.

“That skeleton’s battle-power is so strong.”

The pair of youths within the ship had wide open mouths.

Although the skeletal Division Leader didn’t seem to have the upper hand, it was fighting against three Sovereigns at once.

“What a bastard. The captain’s using this chance to run away.”

The eyebrows of the pretty female furrowed as she watched Zhao Feng run away from the fight with lightning-quick speed.

The handsome male next to her revealed a look of disdain.
